Tick
eventsFunctions.sentence: Run the patrol/chase/attack AI of _PARAM0_ every frame

events.inlineCode: for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimDeath").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimAttack").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimWalk").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimIdle").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimWalk").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
for (const o of objects) { const v = o.getVariables().get("AnimIdle").getAsString(); if (v) o.setAnimationName(v); }
